status: passed focused selector tests and integrated synthetic browser verification
scope: A bilingual optional review plan from existing lesson, grammar, personal-word and arcade evidence. The selector reads saved records; the established practice engines own grading, credit and schedules.
implemented: A pure compact-metadata selector retains only known records, existing due dates and latest recorded attempts. It prioritises overdue mistakes and offers capped 2, 5 or 10 minute plans.

Exact grammar-exercise and normalised-word aliases are deduplicated across tools. Newer evidence supersedes older aliases, including newer future-due evidence. Same-day completions or reviews suppress repeats.
Core lessons remain due-only. Historical word lapse totals are not presented as evidence of the latest failure; personal word recall is explicitly self-assessed.

The hub keeps its time choice in the URL, focuses the heading and opens the specific practice target. Merely opening the hub, changing a budget or opening a practice target does not mutate learner records.
Integrated targeted grammar recall preserves ordinary lesson stage, exercise index, production and first-attempt evidence. A separate pending recall draft survives reload until checked.
Integrated arcade review requires explicit start and preserves any unrelated unfinished round. Exact personal-word review never silently substitutes another due word.

coverage: Mixed record fixtures and deterministic ordering
Existing core due dates and latest review outcomes
Grammar intervals, hints and supported answers
Exact cross-tool deduplication and newer future-due evidence
Today exclusions and stale or unknown IDs
Personal-word self-rating limits and English recall cues

verification.parentIntegratedChecks: Parent reported full typecheck, lint, daily build and 185 daily tests passed after the grammar pending-draft fix.

browser.isolation: Owned standalone headless Chromium and disposable contexts with synthetic localStorage only. No shared CDP, logged-in tabs, existing profile, learner databases or backups accessed.
observations: The mixed fixture produced five due items from all four tools. Budget selection matched the pure selector, survived reload and browser Back, and left raw stored progress unchanged.
Today’s optional review CTA wrapped inside 320px in English and Italian without horizontal overflow. Opening it did not alter records.
An incorrect core recall scheduled tomorrow once. Reloading and entering the correction did not add another review log or alter the original completion credit.

The requested personal word was the second of two due words, rather than the default first word. Revealing was nonmutating; self-rating changed only that word. Reload showed it already reviewed, without substituting the other word.

An unrelated arcade round and its draft remained byte-equivalent when another review was requested. Explicitly starting the requested review created exactly one requested item. Wrong feedback survived reload; finish produced one history record, retained original first evidence and prevented same-day restart.

Target a2-imperfetto-2 started blank instead of exposing the previous submitted answer. An unsubmitted recall draft survived reload separately from ordinary answers. Checking a wrong answer appended one attempt and retained its original attempt, exerciseIndex 6, production output and rubric. Reload showed Already checked today; opening the full unit returned to Use it.
No uncaught page errors or blocked write/off-origin requests were observed. All inspected layouts had document width equal to viewport width.

visualReview.method: Viewed viewport-height screenshots, including the 320px Italian hub, 320px English Today CTA, 1440px English hub and 320px Italian grammar feedback.
visualReview.finding: Controls and correction text wrap within the phone panels; desktop cards retain clear titles and actions. No clipping or horizontal overflow observed in these samples.

resolvedDuringIntegration.finding: Independent review identified that unsubmitted grammar recall was labelled saved but reloaded blank while overwriting the ordinary answer.
resolvedDuringIntegration.resolution: Validated optional recallDrafts store pending answer/date/hint separately. The rebuilt preview passed pre-submit reload and ordinary-answer preservation in both languages.

limitations: Synthetic Chromium samples verify the listed routes and layouts; they do not measure learning outcomes, estimate proficiency or exercise a real learner profile.
Time budgets use deterministic per-item estimates rather than measured personal completion time.
Exact duplicate exercises and words merge; related topics with different exercise IDs remain distinct practice.
The browser audit did not simulate the midnight boundary. Parent engine regression tests cover pending recall draft dates and retained hint evidence.
No remote deployment or real-user study was part of this review.
